title: Kadhalukku Mariyadhai
desc: Jeeva loves Mini, but her three brothers end up beating him every time he meets her. The couple then decide to elope against their parents' wishes.

title: Dharmam Vellum
desc: Tired of being humiliated by his in-laws, Jagannath leaves his family in order to become a police constable. When he returns home to prove his worth, he discovers how his loved ones have changed.

title: Peralagan
desc: Chinna, a phone booth operator, falls for a woman who is blind and wants to help her regain her eyesight. On the other hand, Kartik, his lookalike, is in love with the police commissioner's daughter.

title: En Aasai Rasave
desc: A young boy, working as a street dancer, discovers that his mother is still alive, so he plans to locate her and reunite her with his father.

title: Jayam
desc: Sujatha and Raghu are first cousins who are set to marry each other. But, when Sujatha falls in love with someone else, Raghu decides to beat up her lover.
